sources.title: Church History roundtable on Peter Brown’s Journeys of the Mind, selected contributions
sources.citation: David A.Michelson, Kutlu Akalın, Jelena Bogdanović, Ariel G.López, Elizabeth J.Moodey, Daniel L.Schwartz and Peter Brown, Roundtable on Peter Brown, Journeys of the Mind: A Life in History, Church History 93:4 (December 2024):841–860; copyright/publisher posting 2025.

verification.note: Original open-access Cambridge PDF 20 leaves retrieved. Read introduction 841–842, complete Bogdanović847–850, complete López 850–853, and complete Brown response 858–860. Other sections were encountered only in searches/extract boundaries and are not claimed as complete reading. Each signed voice retains ownership; reviewers’ memoir locators are not direct memoir reading. López’s religion/outsider interpretation and Finley criticism at 852/note 5, and Brown’s response to interpretation, retain qualifications. Roundtable is held-only because these reviewers and Finley lack full endpoints; no forced edge.

ri189_brown_nyrb_interview.note: Complete displayed original publisher interview reread, especially the concluding anthropology answer and distinction between historical otherness and facile present-day analogy. Arjini’s introductory Foucault description remains editorial framing; Brown’s own 2003 lecture and 2022 interview supply the personal debt proposed separately. No audio, complete memoir, cited monograph or independent historical adjudication claimed.
